title: Eritrean Military Commanders Cross Into Zalambesa, Fly Flag on Ethiopian Soil
detail: Senior Eritrean military commanders crossed into Ethiopian territory at the border town of Zalambesa in eastern Tigray in a highly publicized display, openly flying the Eritrean flag as videos circulated on social media. Ethiopian officials and commentators framed the unconcealed incursion as a direct violation of Ethiopia's sovereignty and territorial integrity, with reports describing the Eritrean delegation as received by a TPLF-aligned faction. It came two days after the Shererina battle and amid mounting concern over the alleged 'Tsimdo' coordination between Eritrea and TPLF hardliners.

media.caption: Ethiopian News Agency analysis on the Zalambesa incursion

confidenceReason: Reported primarily through Ethiopian government-aligned outlets (ENA) and an allied think tank; neither the Eritrean government nor the TPLF has publicly confirmed the crossing.
